title: Humility in the Disciples
reading:
Even at the Last Supper, the disciples argued about greatness. Pride survives proximity to Jesus.

Humility requires continual death to self. Even spiritual growth can become spiritual pride.
reflection: Do I compare my spirituality with others? Have I ever felt superior because of my faith? What does servant-hearted leadership look like in my life?
abide: The disciples sat at the table with Jesus and still argued. Nearness to Christ does not automatically produce humility. It must be chosen.
